key_expressions: Where do I change this setting?,

A: Search on SNS isn’t working at all. Do you know why?
Oh really? Then maybe it's just a temporary glitch.
Alright, I’ll try again in a little while.
B: I heard the server’s been unstable since yesterday.
Yes, it happens sometimes but usually goes back to normal quickly.
Right, it should stabilize soon, so please try again later.

A: All the comments suddenly disappeared. Is it just me?
Oh, that kind of restriction could cause this!
Then I should check my account status too.
B: Sometimes posts get hidden automatically if there’s suspected rule violation.
Yes, they usually reappear after some time.
If anything seems off, you can also contact support.

A: I’m getting so many notifications lately that it’s overwhelming.
Oh, being able to adjust them there sounds really convenient!
Then I’ll tidy up my notification categories.
B: In the notification settings, you can turn them off by category.
Yes, there are quite a few you don’t actually need.
Keeping only the important ones makes things much cleaner.

A: My posts keep getting deleted. What could be the reason?
Oh, then it might really be because of the rules.
I guess I should be more careful next time.
B: The auto-filter sometimes reacts a bit strictly.
Yes, certain words or contexts can trigger deletion.
As long as you stay within the rules, posts usually stay up.

A: My account suddenly got locked. Why would that happen?
Oh, failed login attempts could definitely cause that!
Then I’ll reset my password first.
B: If suspicious activity is detected, accounts get locked for security.
Yes, multiple failed logins can trigger it.
Once you reset and verify, it usually unlocks quickly.

A: I’m getting follower recommendations that don’t make any sense.
Oh, so the algorithm can guess like that!
Then I should review my interest settings.
B: It often bases recommendations on recently viewed posts.
Yes, a slight change in your activity can shift recommendations a lot.
Updating your interests usually improves accuracy.

A: Community notifications arrive way too late. It’s inconvenient.
Oh, if it’s because of settings, that should be simple to fix!
Then I’ll set only the important ones to high priority.
B: If the priority is low, notifications can be delayed.
Yes, once you raise the priority they come almost instantly.
Keeping only the essential ones on high priority is efficient.

A: My posts barely get any recommendations. Why is that?
Ah, so timing really matters!
Then I should pay attention to posting at active hours.
B: If the posting time is off, exposure can be low.
Yes, posting when people are active helps a lot.
Right, uploading during high-engagement hours is more effective.

A: Some communities feel so harsh that it’s hard to participate.
Oh, hearing that difference actually helps me understand.
Then I’ll focus on communities that match my vibe.
B: Each community has its own tone and culture.
Yes, some are friendly while others feel more intense.
Finding one that suits you best makes the experience better.

A: I can’t decide how to edit my photos for SNS.
Oh, that style sounds like it would look really nice!
Then I’ll try different filters and choose one I like.
B: A lot of people use aesthetic filters these days.
Yes, even small adjustments can change the whole vibe.
Try a few and pick the one that feels best for you.
